turns.text: For fiscal 2027, we expect consolidated non-GAAP gross margin between 47% and 48%. We are confident in our cost plan.
How much could higher component costs pressure gross margin?
Our plan includes current component costs, but supplier pricing remains uncertain.
If component costs increase further, can you protect the margin range?
We have mitigation options, although we cannot quantify their effect yet.
